response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished senior software engineer with strong technical fundamentals and 15+ years of diverse experience, he lacks several critical required qualifications for this embedded networking security firmware role. Most critically, he has no native-level Japanese language proficiency (a stated requirement), no demonstrated security expertise, and virtually no embedded systems or networking experience. His career has consistently focused on web, backend services, and general software development rather than embedded firmware for LAN-switch security products. The domain gap is too significant for this specialized position.
strengths: Senior-level software engineer with 15+ years of experience currently in a Staff role, demonstrating strong technical leadership and ability to master diverse technical domains
Fluent English speaker meeting language communication requirements; proven track record of learning new technologies and programming languages across multiple platforms
Some Linux and systems-level experience from infrastructure work at Dunnhumby and Altom, plus prior C/C++ experience at National Instruments
concerns: No native-level Japanese language proficiency—an explicitly required qualification that is completely absent from the resume
No demonstrated expertise in security technologies, encryption protocols, authentication systems, device attack detection, or security-focused software development
Minimal embedded systems or networking experience; 15-year career consistently focused on web, backend services, and application development rather than embedded firmware for networking products
